_readme: Language data of the retrieval engine; the code stays language-neutral. To add a language, add a block with these keys. Text is matched lower-cased and with `fold` applied, so write words in folded form. Regex fragments of all languages are joined with |. `months` has 12 slots, January first; leave a slot empty when the word is ambiguous (English `may`). `probes` are everyday questions a knowledge base is unlikely to answer: how close they get measures the noise floor of an embedding model on this base.
